items.requirement: [59] No character illustration redesign; existing day/night fade works and must not regress

items.evidence: No character art was redrawn: the old illustrations are unused, and a separate silhouette (ui_art_protagonist.png) is used in the app. WidgetPaletteFadeTest went with the 3.0.x guide in 3.1.0 (docs/DESIGN_v3.md §19); its coverage of the shared fade code was ported to the plan widget: PaletteHostTest (both palette slots, the settled tree, a crossfade that survives attach and is drawn frame by frame into qa_out/v3/widget/fade; 3 methods × sdk {26,31}), PlanWidgetFadeTest (a resize cancels the running fade; a burst of taps fades once; 2 methods × sdk {26,31}), FadeGuardTest (tap throttle and settle generations, 4 tests) and PlanWidgetBehaviourTest.paletteChangeFadesThenSettles (sdk {26,31}). All of them pass in the 3.1.0 full test run.

items.requirement: [61] Existing fixed-guide widget and progress remain safe alongside adaptive planning
items.label: 3.1.0 之后：旧攻略进度可导出
items.evidence: The old widget itself is not kept: on the owner's directive (drop the old entry and cut ties with the old project, docs/DESIGN_v3.md §19, spec §1.3) the 3.0.x guide page and its home-screen widget are removed. Its progress stays safe: the prefs p3r_native_progress_v1 are kept (owner decision O2) and never written, and 我的 → 备份与恢复 exports them at any time as the old page's file (「导出旧逐日攻略的打勾进度」, shown only when a task is ticked; BackupPage.java:70-141, OldGuideProgress.java). Details: OldGuideProgress.read (OldGuideProgress.java:64-83) uses getAll() only, never an editor, off the main thread. The entry saves through ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT, application/json, default name P3R_打卡进度.json (BackupPage.java:93-103, result handled in HomeActivity.java:195-196). The file is what the old page's exportProgress() wrote, JSON.stringify({format: 'p3r_hunterjia_checklist_v1', completed, completedSubsteps, schemaVersion: 2, exportedAt}, null, 2) (OldGuideProgress.toJson, :86-97), with completed from the prefs' 'completed' and completedSubsteps from 'substeps'. The 2.0.0 app's guide imports that format. OldGuideExportTest (6 tests, all pass in the full run): withoutATickedTaskThereIsNoEntry (looking creates no prefs file either); tickedTasksShowTheEntryWithTheirCount (render qa_out/v3/ui/home_backup_old_guide.png); exportSavesTheOldPagesFileAndLeavesThePrefsAlone (the save intent; saved bytes equal the old page's output, generated by running that expression in Node over the same stored text; the prefs' keys, values and file bytes are unchanged); theFileIsWhatJsonStringifyWrites (key order, escapes, numbers); brokenStoredTextNeverCrashes (broken 'completed' hides the entry, broken 'substeps' export as {}); aFailedSaveSaysSoAndACancelWritesNothing. The 2.0.0 app (app.p3r.dayplanner.test) is a separate package; its guide and progress are untouched. The guide's data stays as pinned sources under rules/sources/cn_guides/.
items.gap: The published 3.1.0 APK does not have this entry. It comes with the next update; until then the ticks stay on the phone (O2). docs/RELEASE_NOTES_3.1.0.md, README.md (下载) and docs/DESIGN_v3.md §19 say so. An old 「P3R 逐日攻略」 widget stops working after the update to 3.1.0, and the notes tell players to remove it. Only the prefs are read, not the 3.0.x WebView storage. That page mirrored every tick into the prefs (syncState), and its widget wrote there directly. This check did not run the system file picker on a device, and it did not import into an installed 2.0.0 app. The format is checked against the old page's own export expression.
